Érica, tomorrow is my free day. What is the best place in São Paulo?
Number one: the Municipal Market. It's the most famous market in the city.
A market! In Boston, the most famous market is Quincy Market. Is your market crowded?
Yes, very crowded. Go early. And the mortadella sandwich is delicious!
Great. What is number two?
Ibirapuera Park. For me, it's the most beautiful place in São Paulo.
I love parks. And the best restaurant? I want Italian food. It's my favorite.
Bella Mesa, in Pinheiros. It's the most popular restaurant there. Not the cheapest, but the best.
Perfect. And the worst thing in São Paulo?
The traffic! Six o'clock is the worst time.

Hi, Érica. It's Mark again. Thank you for your top three! Today I went to the Municipal Market. It's the most famous market in the city, and it was the most crowded place of my day. The mortadella sandwich was the biggest sandwich of my life! Then I walked in Ibirapuera Park. For me, it's the most beautiful place in São Paulo. The worst part of the day? The traffic at six o'clock. See you tomorrow at the office!

Good morning, and welcome to City Top Three. Today: restaurants in Pinheiros. Number three is Casa Verde. It's the cheapest restaurant on our list, and the food is good. Number two is Sol. It has the best view, but it's the most expensive. And number one is Bella Mesa. It's the most popular restaurant in Pinheiros, and the pasta is delicious. Is it the quietest? No. It's the noisiest, but it's the best!
